description: This Java file contains unit tests for the ImmutableAccessControlList class, a part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package. The tests verify immutability, equality, merge behaviors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and permissions management within access control list (ACL) objects.

classes.name: ImmutableAccessControlListTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutableAccessControlList class, focusing on immutability, equality, merging, JSON serialization/deserialization, and permissions management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes an empty ACL before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAccessControlList instances are effectively immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of equals and hashCode using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: emptyAclIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that a newly created ACL is empty.

methods.name: emptyAclHasSizeZero
methods.description: Checks that a new ACL reports size zero.

methods.name: mergeAclEntryWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies merging an ACL entry results in correct inclusion.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsForWritePermission
methods.description: Checks retrieval of subjects authorized for write permission.

methods.name: mergeAuthorizationSubjectWithMultiplePermissions
methods.description: Tests merging a subject with multiple permissions.

methods.name: mergeEntryCreatesDisjointAcl
methods.description: Ensures merging entries creates a disjoint ACL set.

methods.name: tryToSetNullAclEntry
methods.description: Ensures null entries cannot be set (throws NullPointerException).

methods.name: setEntryCreatesDisjointAcl
methods.description: Tests setting an entry creates a disjoint ACL.

methods.name: tryToGetAclEntryForNullAuthoriztionSubject
methods.description: Ensures getting entry for null subject throws exception.

methods.name: getAclEntryForAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the ACL entry for a specific authorization subject.

methods.name: tryToGetPermissionsForNullAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Ensures null input when getting permissions throws exception.

methods.name: getPermissionsForBarSubject
methods.description: Checks permissions associated with a specific subject.

methods.name: checkPermissionsForAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Verifies permission checks for an authorization subject.

methods.name: mergeAclPermissionWithMultipleAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Tests merging permissions across multiple subjects.

methods.name: getAuthorizedSubjectsForAdministratePermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects authorized for ADMINISTRATE permission.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the reported size of the ACL.

methods.name: removeLastPermissionOfAuthorizationSubjectRemovesWholeAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Checks removing the last permission removes the subject.

methods.name: removeSoleEntryOfAcl
methods.description: Removes the only entry, resulting in an empty ACL.

methods.name: removeAllPermissionsOfBazSubject
methods.description: Removes all permissions of a specific subject.

methods.name: getEntriesReturnsDisjointSet
methods.description: Verifies that getting entries produces a disjoint set.

methods.name: tryToCreateAclFromNullJsonObject
methods.description: Ensures creation from null JSON throws exception.

methods.name: createAccessControlListFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests parsing ACL from valid JSON.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpectedJsonObject
methods.description: Checks the JSON serialization output.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Verifies that setting null permissions throws exception.

methods.name: setEmptyPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjectsCreatesEmptyAcl
methods.description: Sets permissions to empty and checks the ACL is empty.

methods.name: setPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Sets a uniform permission for all subjects.

methods.name: removeAclEntryFromAclWithoutThisEntry
methods.description: Attempting to remove a non-existent entry leaves ACL unchanged.

methods.name: setPermissionsForAllAuthorizationSubjectsOnEmptyAcl
methods.description: Sets permissions on an empty ACL; results in same empty ACL.

methods.name: ensureAclToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Checks that converting to builder and back preserves ACL.
